messages:
Maria: FYI customer GreenFin opened an escalation: embeddings coming back with different lengths depending on endpoint. Hosted -> 1536, Dedicated -> 1024. They started noticing after last night's deployment. They're worried about their FAISS indexes mixing dims. Ticket SF-4421.

ops-bot: New escalation assigned to #support. Severity=P2. Attachments: customer logs, sample request ids.

Alex: Can you paste the exact requests/responses (sanitized)? Need model name, endpoint URLs, and any model-variant headers. Also what region / pool the dedicated traffic hit.

Maria: Pasted sanitized snippets below. Both requests identical except the host.

---

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd/embedding-large-v2","input":"Where is the Eiffel Tower located?"}'

Hosted response (trimmed):
{
  \"data\": [{\"embedding\": [0.0001, 0.0002, ..., /*1536 values*/]}],
  \"model\": \"rwd/embedding-large-v2\",
  \"usage\": {\"units\": 1}
}

Dedicated request to: https://dedicated-us-west.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
Dedicated response (trimmed):
{
  \"data\": [{\"embedding\": [0.0003, 0.0004, ..., /*1024 values*/]}],
  \"model\": \"rwd/embedding-large-v2-quant\",
  \"usage\": {\"units\": 1}
}
---

Alex: That model name in the dedicated response (\"-quant\") is the smoking gun. Sounds like a quantized variant was served from the customer's dedicated pool. @Sachin can you check pool config and any recent template changes?

Sachin: Looking. GreenFin is on dedicated pool gp-dedicated-gf-01. I can see a config key model_override=\"embedding-large-v2-quant\" applied in the pool spec. That override was supposed to be limited to demo/test pools only. It looks like a deployment template with that tag was used accidentally during last night's update. Opening an internal change CHG-7831.

Jordan: Two immediate problems: 1) parity (same canonical model name yielding different dims across deployments) and 2) billing confusion (customer billed at hosted unit rate but got a lower-dim vector on dedicated). We should stop silent downgrades.

Emily: Repro I ran from my laptop: hosted -> 1536 dims, dedicated pool -> 1024 dims, private (Edge appliance in customer's VPC) -> 1536 dims. So only that dedicated pool is affected. Adding header X-Redwood-Model-Version did not force the full model; variant override at pool-level takes precedence. Batching tests unchanged.

Alex: Risk if we flip pool to full model now? memory/costs?

Sachin: Full model uses ~25% more GPU memory. Options: 1) modify pool to use full model (causes rolling restart ~45s), 2) migrate customer to an existing pool with full model replicas (hot swap routing), or 3) maintain quant and clearly surface variant name to customer (bad UX). I recommend migration to a full-model pool and short maintenance window.

Maria: Customer says they already ingested some vectors into FAISS. Mixing dims will corrupt indexes. Urgent ask: stop ingestion and don't run similarity queries against mixed-index until we confirm.

Jordan: Proposed immediate actions:
- Tell GreenFin to pause new writes (Assigned: Maria)
- Migrate traffic to full-model pool or Hosted (Assigned: Sachin)
- Investigate billing discrepancy and prepare interim credits (Assigned: Emily)
- Add parity guard in platform that detects dim mismatch across deployments for same canonical model name (Assigned: Eng-ML)

Emily: For billing we need request timestamps or ids. Maria, can you ask customer for sample request ids so we can scope the window?

Maria: They sent three sample ids: rid_A1, rid_B2, rid_C3 and reported window 2026-03-13T23:40:00Z -> 2026-03-14T02:10:00Z.

ops-bot: Change CHG-7831 created: rollback/migrate plan.

Sachin: Migration plan:
1) Provision migration pool in us-west-2 with full model replicas.
2) Split-route GreenFin to migration pool (start at 100% once validated).
3) Run validation suite of 200 customer inputs comparing dims and cosine similarity to hosted. Threshold: dim equality + median cos >= 0.95.
4) Cut traffic, monitor metrics for 30 minutes.
5) Remove erroneous model_override tag from template.

Validation snippet I'm running in our harness:
```
for s in samples.jsonl:
  a = call(hooked_hosted_url, model=\"rwd/embedding-large-v2\", input=s)
  b = call(mig_url, model=\"rwd/embedding-large-v2\", input=s)
  assert len(a[\"embedding\"]) == len(b[\"embedding\"]) 
  if cosine(a.embedding, b.embedding) < 0.95:
    log.warn(s)
```

Alex: Also capture X-Redwood-Model-Variant and X-Redwood-Quantization response headers for each validation call so we can prove what variant served. Short-term: if a node tries to serve a different-dim vector for a canonical model name, respond with HTTP 409 and an explanatory message instead of mismatching silently. That will prevent index poisoning.

Emily: Billing calc approach: credit = sum_over_requests((canonical_dim - served_dim)/canonical_dim * unit_price). We'll compute after we extract request counts from logs. Recommend proactive goodwill credit even beyond strict calculation.

Sachin: Migration executed. Summary: provisioned pool, validated 200 samples, all dims 1536, median cosine=0.98 vs hosted. Flipped GreenFin traffic at 1769880000. Removed model_override from template. Minor blip: ~30s of marginal increased latency during reprovisioning, no errors.

Maria: Customer confirms they paused ingestion and resumed only after we validated. Quick smoke test on their side shows similarity search working. They asked for a postmortem and assurances.

Jordan: Postmortem action items:
- Root cause: deployment template accidentally included model_override for some dedicated pools (Owner: Eng-Platform)
- Short-term mitigation: block application of model_override on customer pools, require manual opt-in (Owner: Eng-Platform)
- Platform change: dim-parity enforcement + 409-on-mismatch (Owner: Eng-ML)
- Observability: weekly scan of dedicated pools for variant vs canonical mismatch (Owner: Eng-SRE)
- Billing: issue credit and apology (Owner: Finance)

Maria: Drafting customer RCA and postmortem doc now. Will include logs, validation screenshots, and CHG details.

Emily: Billing team will prepare provisional credit and wait for final request counts. We're leaning toward full goodwill credit for trust.

ops-bot: Ticket SF-4421 status updated to Resolved-Pending-Postmortem.

SupportBot: Thanks team. Closing thread until postmortem published. If GreenFin sees any anomalies, re-open support ticket.

Maria: Thanks all for the quick turnaround. I'll upload the PM and notify the customer when it's posted.
